function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### What Makes “the Best” Men’s Underwear? When people ask what the *best* men’s underwear looks like, they’re usually looking for: | Factor | Why It Matters | |--------|----------------| | **Fit & Comfort** | Avoids chafing, provides proper support without digging into skin. | | **Material** | Breathability, softness, stretch, moisture‑wicking ability. | | **Durability / Care** | How long it lasts after repeated wash cycles; how easy it is to care for. | | **Style Purpose** | Everyday casual vs athletic performance vs formal occasions. | Below you’ll find a quick guide to each major style, plus key points to consider when choosing your next pair. --- ## 1️⃣ Briefs > Classic cut – snug around hips, no leg coverage beyond waistline. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Great support for active use (running, gym)
• Minimal bulk under clothing
• Good for tight pants | • Can feel restrictive if too tight
• Less airflow than other cuts | | Ideal For | Sports, workouts, daily wear where you don’t mind a tighter waistband. | | Top Brands | Calvin Klein, Hanes, Jockey, Tommy Hilfiger. | | Material Tips | Look for spandex blends (~5–10%) for elasticity; cotton‑polyester mixes for breathability. | --- ## 2️⃣ Boxers > Loose, full‑leg cut—think beach shorts meets underwear. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Excellent ventilation
• Comfortable for lounging
• Wide variety of prints/designs | • Not ideal for high‑impact activities
• May bunch up inside jeans/pants | | Ideal For | Casual days at home, travel, light activity. | | Top Brands | Fruit of the Loom, Dockers, Mack Weldon, Uniqlo. | | Material Tips | Pure cotton or bamboo gives natural softness; avoid heavy polyester blends unless you need extra durability. | --- ## 3️⃣ Boxer Briefs (Boxer‑Brief Hybrid) > Combines the length of boxers with the support of briefs. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Provides both support and coverage
• Reduces friction against trousers
• Versatile across many body types | • Still may feel bulky if not sized correctly
• Some designs have visible seams | | Ideal For | Daily wear, commuting, moderate exercise. | | Top Brands | Nike Pro, Under Armour Tech, Adidas Performance, Lululemon Align. | | Material Tips | Moisture‑wicking tech fibers (e.g., CoolMax, Dri‑FIT); look for flatlock stitching to reduce irritation. | --- ## 4️⃣ Trunks (Short‑Leg Boxer Briefs) > Shorter legs than traditional boxer briefs; often called “shorty” or “trunk.” | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Sleek profile fits well under slim‑cut pants
• Reduced risk of fabric pulling during movement
• Often lighter weight | • Limited coverage might cause discomfort for larger thighs
• Might show more line through tight shirts | | Ideal For | Fashion-forward wardrobes, skinny jeans, low‑profile sports gear. | | Top Brands | Calvin Klein, Polo Ralph Lauren, Hugo Boss, ASICS. | | Material Tips | Lightweight microfiber blends; check for reinforced corners for longevity. | --- ## 5️⃣ Compression Shorts (Athletic Support) > Tight-fitting, designed specifically for muscle support and sweat management. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Keeps muscles stable during intense workouts
• Excellent sweat wicking
• Helps prevent blisters | • Very tight—may feel uncomfortable outside workout context
• Requires careful washing to maintain compression properties | | Ideal For | High‑intensity training, running, cycling, yoga. | | Top Brands | 2XU, Skins, Reebok Nano, Power Systems. | | Material Tips | Lycra/spandex blends with micro‑fiber technology; ensure elastic stays intact after multiple washes. | --- ## 6️⃣ G-String / Thong (Minimal Coverage) These are niche options primarily chosen for aesthetic reasons or extreme minimalism. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Zero panty lines
• Extremely lightweight | • Lack of support
• Potential for accidental exposure | | Ideal For | Swimwear, very form‑fitting outfits, personal preference. | | Top Brands | Victoria's Secret (for women), but male-specific options from brands like H&M or local boutiques. | | Material Tips | Soft nylon or modal blends; always test for seam placement before wearing. | --- ## Quick Decision Matrix | Need | Choose… | |------|---------| | **Maximum support + low bulk** | Briefs or compression shorts | | **All-day breathable comfort** | Boxers | | **Versatility (support + coverage)** | Boxer briefs | | **Slim silhouette, less visible lines** | Trunks | | **Extreme minimalism** | G-string/thong | --- ## Sizing Cheat Sheet | Body Type | Suggested Cut | Waist Size Tip | |-----------|---------------|----------------| | Slim build | Trunks or brief | Aim for waist size minus one inch | | Average build | Boxer briefs | Standard waist measurement works | | Larger thighs | Full-length boxers or longer boxer briefs | Add 1–2 inches to standard waist size | | Tall stature | Longer boxer briefs/trunks | Check product height specs | Always read the specific brand’s sizing chart because measurements vary between manufacturers. --- ## Fabric Spotlight | Fiber | Key Benefits | Typical Use Case | |-------|--------------|------------------| | Cotton | Natural, soft, absorbent | Everyday lounge, sensitive skin | | Bamboo | Eco-friendly, antibacterial, ultra-soft | Luxury loungewear, eco-conscious shoppers | | Modal | Smooth texture, excellent drape | Premium underwear, summer wear | | Polyester/Lycra blend | Stretchable, durable, dries fast | Athletic wear, outdoor activities | | Merino wool | Temperature regulation, odor control | Cold climates, extended trips | If you’re prone to allergies or heat sensitivity, opt for hypoallergenic materials like organic cotton or bamboo. If sweating heavily, prioritize moisture‑wicking synthetic blends. --- ## Maintenance Hacks 1. **Wash Inside Out:** Protect delicate seams and colors. 2. **Avoid Hot Water:** Heat can shrink elastics and degrade fibers. 3. **Skip Dryer Sheets:** These leave residue that clogs pores. Air dry whenever possible. 4. **Use Gentle Detergents:** Especially for premium fabrics. 5. **Rotate Regularly:** Wear different pairs each day to extend lifespan. --- ## Final Takeaway There isn’t a single “one-size-fits-all” best style—it depends on lifestyle, climate, and personal comfort preferences. However, most modern consumers gravitate toward **boxer briefs** for their balanced mix of support, coverage, and versatility. Pair them with quality fabrics (cotton‑spandex blends or advanced moisture‑wicking tech) and you'll get comfortable, durable underwear suitable for almost everything life throws at you. Happy shopping!
